1041Transport services

Supply Chain Inventory Rebalancer

Space · vaibhavpai/supply-chain

Transfer stock between three warehouses across five SKUs over 30-45 days to minimise stockouts and holding and shipping costs.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • process-supervision rewards
  • seeded deterministic evaluation

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Per-step reward combines fulfilled-demand credit, stockout, holding and shipping penalties and process-supervision bonuses; env.grade() gives an episode score.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python run_episode_demo.py --task 2 --agent greedy

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/vaibhavpai/supply-chain
cd supply-chain

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.
